name.zh: 受 Wielandiella 启发的叉枝灌木

description.en: Give the branch forks priority over leaf density; use the revised organismal reconstruction rather than old flower drawings.
description.zh: 突出叉枝而非叶片密度，采用修订整株重建而非旧花形绘图。

sources.title: A revision of Wielandiella angustifolia
sources.supports: Branched bennettitalean shrub with associated leaves and immature cones.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Nominal scale, palette, pose, leaf/root/frond counts and fine relief are artistic. Original geometry only; no exact species, microscopic, locality, salinity or coexistence restoration. Limnobiophyllum mounting origin is the freshwater waterline; its roots extend below it.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 名义尺度、配色、姿态、叶/根/羽片数量及细小起伏为美术选择。仅含原创几何；不主张精确物种、显微结构、地点、耐盐性或同域共存复原。Limnobiophyllum 原点为淡水水面，根部下垂。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
